fusions.name: Sawing Grip
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 13 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Reckless Windmill
fusions.desc: A full-arm swing that deals 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Shoulder to the Blade
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Cornered Silverback
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, your physical damage rises by 40% for 8 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
